skill.name: report-generator
skill.description: Generate structured Markdown, HTML, and PDF reports from data, including summaries, tables, charts, and performance comparisons.
skill.summary: Create polished data reports with summaries, tables, charts, and export guidance.
skill.author: CuriousLearner

security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution and blocker findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline formatting, CSS, and dictionary method names. One network finding is confirmed because the HTML template loads Chart.js from a third-party CDN. A semantic review found unescaped data inserted into generated HTML and JavaScript.

remediation.suggestion: Escape all HTML text, serialize chart values with a JSON encoder, and sanitize or reject unsafe input before report generation.
Pin the dependency with integrity metadata, offer a local bundle option, or let users disable external scripts in generated reports.

semantic_findings.title: Unescaped Data in Generated HTML
semantic_findings.description: The HTML report examples insert titles, metrics, table cells, and chart fields directly into HTML and JavaScript. Reports built from untrusted data could execute injected markup or script when opened.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly interpolates input-controlled values into HTML and JavaScript without escaping or JSON serialization. Multiple sinks make browser-side injection likely if source data is untrusted.

content.value_statement: Raw data often needs clear summaries before teams can act. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to produce Markdown, HTML, and PDF-ready reports.
actual_capabilities: Builds executive summary structures with highlights, performance tables, and recommendations.
Creates data analysis report sections for quality checks, statistics, correlations, and insights.
Provides HTML report templates with responsive styling and chart containers.
Generates Markdown tables with optional column alignment.
Shows chart generation patterns for bar, line, pie, and scatter visuals.
Includes PDF export guidance using Markdown conversion and WeasyPrint.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and examples, not a packaged report application.
Users must supply clean data and verify computed insights.
HTML examples need escaping before use with untrusted data.
PDF export depends on local Python libraries and system rendering support.

use_cases.title: Summarize Business Metrics
use_cases.description: Turn recurring business data into an executive summary with key metrics, changes, and recommendations.

use_cases.title: Document Data Quality
use_cases.description: Create a structured report that explains missing values, duplicates, type issues, and statistical summaries.

use_cases.title: Compare Performance Baselines
use_cases.description: Generate a comparison report that highlights stable, improved, and degraded metrics against a baseline.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a clear report outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use report-generator to create a Markdown report from this dataset. Include a title, summary, key metrics, and recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Data Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Use report-generator to review this table for missing values, duplicate rows, type issues, and useful statistical summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Build an HTML Dashboard Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use report-generator to produce an HTML report with responsive sections, tables, and chart descriptions for this data.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Current Results to Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use report-generator to compare these current metrics with the baseline. Highlight material changes, likely causes, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Monthly sales data with revenue, order volume, and conversion rate.
output_examples.output: A report with an executive summary, metric table, trend notes, and recommended follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: Customer support export with ticket status, response time, and priority.
output_examples.output: A data quality report that lists missing fields, duplicate records, summary statistics, and operational insights.

output_examples.input: Current service metrics and a previous baseline.
output_examples.output: A performance comparison that labels each metric as stable, improved, or degraded and explains the impact.

best_practices: Escape values before creating HTML or JavaScript output.
Include data sources, date ranges, and methodology in every report.
Match chart types to the question and keep recommendations evidence-based.
anti_patterns: Publishing generated HTML from untrusted data without sanitization.
Using decorative charts that do not support a decision.
Mixing executive summaries and raw analysis without clear section headings.

faq.question: What formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It gives patterns for Markdown, HTML, chart images, and PDF-ready reports.

faq.question: Does it calculate statistics?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples cover counts, missing values, duplicates, descriptive statistics, correlations, and metric changes.

faq.question: Can it create charts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for bar, line, pie, scatter, and Chart.js-style report visuals.

faq.question: Is the HTML safe for untrusted data?
faq.answer: Not by default. Escape text and serialize chart data safely before publishing generated HTML.

faq.question: Can it compare two datasets?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes comparison patterns for baseline and current metrics.

faq.question: Does it install reporting software?
faq.answer: No. It is a guidance skill with examples, and users provide any needed local tools.
